plan.interpretation: Approved mechanical reconstruction, NOT exact published-study replication.

source_rules.entry: M15 closes inside a zone after the previous completed close was outside. Approach from above buys, from below sells.

reconstruction_assumptions.pivot_confirmation: 2 completed D1 bars on either side of body high/low; never wicks.
reconstruction_assumptions.zone_clustering: Price-sorted pivots greedily clustered into disjoint bands of maximum 60 pips; minimum 5-pip centered padding.
reconstruction_assumptions.duplicate_touches: Multiple pivots from a single daily candle count once within each band.
reconstruction_assumptions.aging: Daily rebuild from only the last 730 calendar days; breaks do not invalidate bands.
reconstruction_assumptions.target: Fixed 2R proxy, not the original nearest-structure variable target.
reconstruction_assumptions.concurrency: One open position per pair; signals during an open position skipped, no queue.
reconstruction_assumptions.high_water: Highest observed closed account balance per isolated pair, not floating equity or a combined FX account.

limitations: This is an approved mechanical proxy, not the author’s exact unpublished code. Fixed 2R targets differ from the original nearest-structure target. No claim to reproduce +493%.
Pre-2026 trading relies on generated ticks.
Only three approved pairs, not the original 16-pair combined portfolio.
comparison: Two independent account sizing methods; no combined portfolio.
